generate_commandlines_from_metadata: generate commandlines to process metadata.json files found recursively in an input directory
run_with_input_and_output_dirs: run the script with --input_dir and --output_dir to generate image pair commandlines
run_with_environment_prefix: run the script with --prefix to prepend environment setup commands to generated commandlines
skip_already_processed_scenes: skip scenes where the output metadata.json already exists to avoid reprocessing
list_metadata_files_recursively: list all metadata.json files under an input directory using recursive glob matching
